description: This file defines the Compiler class for the Twig templating engine, including methods for compiling nodes, managing source code, and generating PHP code.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling Twig nodes into PHP code, managing source code generation, debug info, and code formatting.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the Environment object associated with this compiler.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current source code being compiled.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the compiler's internal state, optionally setting indentation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a given Node object with specified indentation.

methods.name: subcompile
methods.description: Subcompiles a Node object, optionally with raw formatting.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Adds raw string to the compiled code.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes strings to the source code with indentation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Adds a quoted string to the source code.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Converts a value to its PHP code representation.

methods.name: addDebugInfo
methods.description: Adds debugging information for a Node.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decreases indentation level, throws exception if it would become negative.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique variable name for code generation.

methods.name: checkForEcho
methods.description: Checks if a string contains echo or print statements and updates internal state.
